changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: Trim the codes of existing terminology mappings.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.test_terminology_mapping t SET code = trim(t.code) WHERE t.code <> trim(t.code) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.test_terminology_mapping o WHERE o.id <> t.id AND o.test_id = t.test_id AND o.source = t.source AND o.component_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.component_id AND o.sample_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.sample_type_id AND trim(o.code) = trim(t.code) AND (o.code = trim(o.code) OR o.id < t.id)); UPDATE clinlims.sample_type_terminology_mapping t SET code = trim(t.code) WHERE t.code <> trim(t.code) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.sample_type_terminology_mapping o WHERE o.id <> t.id AND o.sample_type_id = t.sample_type_id AND o.source = t.source AND trim(o.code) = trim(t.code) AND (o.code = trim(o.code) OR o.id < t.id)); UPDATE clinlims.panel_terminology_mapping t SET code = trim(t.code) WHERE t.code <> trim(t.code) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.panel_terminology_mapping o WHERE o.id <> t.id AND o.panel_id = t.panel_id AND o.source = t.source AND trim(o.code) = trim(t.code) AND (o.code = trim(o.code) OR o.id < t.id)); UPDATE clinlims.dictionary_terminology_mapping t SET code = trim(t.code) WHERE t.code <> trim(t.code) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.dictionary_terminology_mapping o WHERE o.id <> t.id AND o.dictionary_id = t.dictionary_id AND o.source = t.source AND trim(o.code) = trim(t.code) AND (o.code = trim(o.code) OR o.id < t.id));
